clauses.title: Statement of Work
clauses.text: Quantica shall perform engineering services as described in mutually agreed Statements of Work.

clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.text: All Work Product shall be the sole property of Quantica. Customer is granted a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license to use the Work Product for its internal business purposes.

clauses.title: Indemnification
clauses.text: Customer shall indemnify, defend, and hold Quantica harmless from any and all third-party claims, including those arising from Quantica's own negligence.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party agrees to protect the other party's Confidential Information for a period of three (3) years following disclosure.

risk_findings.risk: All IP retained by vendor; customer has revocable license only
